title: Quinlan Vos
description: Quinlan Vos wasn't the usual Jedi Master. Brash and unconventional, he was nevertheless an excellent tracker. The Jedi Council gave Vos the difficult assignment of getting close to Count Dooku so he could assassinate him. Vos unexpectedly fell in love with Asajj Ventress and was forced to learn the ways of the dark side of the Force. Vos came close to falling to the dark side, but Ventress sacrificed her own life to save him.
